from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents the extraction of company name and undistributed profit from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the report")
    undistributed_profit: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of undistributed profit in yuan")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned in the document")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the company name and profit value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profit_records: list[CompanyProfitRecord]
